# Test fixtures

IMPORTANT: these files are SYNTHETIC. They are modelled on the description of a real Mountain
Project tick entry (route title with grade, route link, GUID, pubDate, HTML description with
area breadcrumbs) but they were NOT recorded from the live feeds, because the build
environment could not reach mountainproject.com. Names, IDs and dates are invented.

After the first real workflow run, compare the "Feed report" in the log with these fixtures
and replace/add a sanitised real entry if the real format differs.
